title: Can Older or Less Mobile Travellers Do a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Often yes, if you can walk a short way and take one careful step from the pontoon onto the boat. Tell us your needs first. Wheelchair users, ask us first.
heroAlt: Older couple seen from behind walking along a Funchal marina pontoon towards a white motor boat
keywords: can older people do a boat trip in madeira
boarding a boat from a pontoon

images.prompt: Morning at Marina do Funchal, Madeira. Seen from the pontoon at eye level: an older couple, seen from behind, walking slowly along a floating pontoon towards a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, moored alongside. A skipper in a plain polo shirt stands on the pontoon by the boat, seen from the side at a distance, hand held out. Behind, the Funchal hillside with white houses and red roofs. Calm water, soft morning light, true colours.
images.alt: Older couple seen from behind walking along a Funchal marina pontoon towards a white motor boat
